papers.title: Another red alert for American science | Science
papers.summary: Although research has bipartisan support in the US Congress, and trust in science is above 75% across the country, the Trump administration seems as determined as ever to mortally wound the nation’s scientific enterprise. After the scientific community persuaded Congress to restore most of the president’s draconian cuts to research funding last year, the White House Office of Management and Budget (OMB), under Russell Vought, has found new ways to circumvent the will of Congress and starve American science. At the beginning of this year, OMB dragged its feet in releasing instructions to federal agencies for how to distribute the funding appropriated by Congress, leading to lags in dispersal. Now, OMB has proposed revising the rules that govern how federal dollars are spent. The changes would inevitably lead to unlegislated reductions in funding and damage US leadership in science, both in academia and industry
papers.llm_title_zh: 美国科学界再度面临严峻挑战 | 《科学》杂志
papers.llm_title_bilingual: 美国科学界再度面临严峻挑战 | 《科学》杂志 / Another red alert for American science | Science
papers.llm_research_question_zh: 尽管这项研究得到了美国国会的两党支持，而且全国范围内对科学的信任度也超过了75%，但特朗普政府似乎依然决心要严重破坏这个国家的科研事业。
llm_highlights_zh: 在科学界去年说服国会撤销总统对研究经费的那些严厉削减措施之后，由拉塞尔·沃特领导的白宫管理和预算办公室又找到了新的手段来规避国会的决定，从而继续扼杀美国的科学研究事业。
今年年初，美国行政管理办公室在向各联邦机构发布有关如何分配国会拨款的指示方面拖延了时间，从而导致资金分配出现延迟。
目前，OMB提议修订那些规范联邦资金使用方式的规则。
papers.llm_rss_summary_zh: 尽管在美国国会中，这项研究计划得到了两党的支持，而且全国范围内对科学的信任度也超过了75%，但特朗普政府似乎依然决心要严重破坏美国的科研事业。去年，在科学界的努力下，国会最终迫使总统撤销了那些针对科研资金的严厉削减措施。然而，在拉塞尔·沃特的领导下，白宫管理预算办公室又找到了新的手段来规避国会的决定，继续扼杀美国的科学研究。今年年初，该部门迟迟没有向各联邦机构下达关于如何分配国会拨款的指示，从而导致资金分配工作出现了延误。如今，白宫管理预算办公室又提议修改那些规范联邦资金使用方式的规则。这些变更无疑会导致资金被非法削减，进而损害美国在学术界和工业界的科研领导地位。

papers.title: RFX7 is a tumor suppressor that restricts MYC function and B cell activation
papers.summary: Our results show that the transcription factor RFX7 acts as a tumor suppressor in mouse models of B cell lymphoma. RFX7 limits the activity of MYC, a key regulator of B cell activation and lymphomagenesis. We also demonstrate that alterations of RFX7 found in lymphomas can substantially affect its transcriptional activity and patient prognosis

all_papers.primary_summary_raw: Our results show that the transcription factor RFX7 acts as a tumor suppressor in mouse models of B cell lymphoma. RFX7 limits the activity of MYC, a key regulator of B cell activation and lymphomagenesis. We also demonstrate that alterations of RFX7 found in lymphomas can substantially affect its transcriptional activity and patient prognosis
